summary: The root أزز (azz) primarily describes a state of agitation, excitement, or intense provocation. It can refer to a strong urging or incitement, often with a sense of disturbance or unrest.

headwords.gloss: The cooking-pot made a sound in boiling; boiled; boiled vehemently

parts.t: The cooking-pot made a sound in boiling:
(S, accord. to an explanation there given of the inf. n.; and A:) or
(K.) It is said in a trad.,
كَانَ يُصَلِّى وَ لِجَوْفِهِ أَزِيز كَأَزِيزِ ٱلْمِرْجَلِ مِنَ ٱلْبُكَآءِ
He used to pray, his inside making a sound like the sound of the boiling of the cooking-pot, by reason of weeping
]: (S, A, Mgh:) this is said of Mohammad:

headwords.def: أَزَّتِ القِدْرُ , (S, K,) or البُرْمَةُ , (A,) aor اَزُزَ (S, K) and اَزِزَ , (K,) inf. n. أَزِيزٌ (S, A, K) and أَزٌّ and أَزَازٌ , (K,) The cooking-pot made a sound in boiling: (S, accord. to an explanation there given of the inf. n.; and A:) or boiled: (S:) or boiled vehemently; (K;) as also [written with the disjunctive alif اِيتَّزَّت ], (S, K,) inf. n. ٱئْتِزَازٌ ; (S;) and , (K,) inf. N. تَأَزُّزٌ : (TA:) or all signify it boiled not vehemently. (K.) It is said in a trad., كَانَ يُصَلِّى وَ لِجَوْفِهِ أَزِيز كَأَزِيزِ ٱلْمِرْجَلِ مِنَ ٱلْبُكَآءِ (tropical:) [ He used to pray, his inside making a sound like the sound of the boiling of the cooking-pot, by reason of weeping ]: (S, A, Mgh:) this is said of Mohammad: ازيز meaning

headwords.gloss: He becomes angry, and distressed, and disquieted; disturbed, by reason of such a thing

parts.t: He becomes angry, and distressed, and disquieted
disturbed, by reason of such a thing.

headwords.def: ائتزّت القِدْرُ : see 1. هُوَ يَأْتَزُّ مِنْ كَذَا He becomes angry, and distressed, and disquieted or disturbed, by reason of such a thing. (A, TA.)
أَزِيزٌ inf. n. of 1. Sharpness; syn. حِدَّةٌ . (TA.)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
